title: KeyError: 'x-forwarded-for' when extracting client IP from internal service requests
description: Direct internal traffic and VPC private subnet calls that bypass the public CloudFront proxy do not supply the 'x-forwarded-for' header, causing the rate limiter to crash with an unhandled KeyError.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/rate_limiter.py', line 11, in extract_client_ip
    forwarded_for = headers['x-forwarded-for']
KeyError: 'x-forwarded-for'
recent_changes: Commit e710aa: Implemented IP-based token bucket rate limiting
expected_behavior: Should use headers.get('x-forwarded-for') and fallback to '127.0.0.1' when missing
